subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Liverpool–Manchester Railway
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Liverpool–Manchester Railway.

hook.text: In 1830, the world's first intercity passenger railway opened. Travel changed overnight.

buildup.text: Scheduled departures, printed tickets, fixed fares—stagecoach ideas, scaled up on steam power.

discovery.text: On opening day, dignitaries watched. Then a politician stepped onto the tracks and was killed.

twist.text: Despite the tragedy, half a million passengers rode the line in its first year.

climax.text: Within a decade, Britain had over 1,500 miles of railway track. A revolution had begun.

punchline.text: One line between two cities rewired a nation.

quiz.question: What was historic about the Liverpool–Manchester Railway?
options: First intercity passenger railway with scheduled service
